assumptions.statement: Positions, Lagna and vargas come from the Phase 5 Kundli (Lahiri ayanamsa, whole-sign houses); Raman used his own ayanamsa.
Cheshta Bala is computed in the frame of Raman's mean-motion tables (Raman ayanamsa), extrapolated only for the years 1800-2100.
Ayana Bala uses the tropical longitude reconstructed as the Lahiri longitude plus the Lahiri ayanamsa.
The birth time is exact; with an unknown time only Naisargika Bala is evaluated and no total is produced.

authority_note: Totals follow one modern manual (B. V. Raman, Graha and Bhava Balas) as implemented and checked on its worked example; they are not a universally authoritative Shadbala, and other manuals and the BPHS verses differ in places.
